title: `packages: null` on a release artifact: the schema and `composeStacks` refuse it, while every reader reads it as absent
body:
Ruled: 5805260775 · letter A (class-1) · 2026-09-24T00:31Z

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357) from the out-of-scope findings of the #15293 dev (report `5801982470`; PR #19924). The #15293 dispatch put `null` out of scope on purpose, and ruling A (`5634034754`) names `{}`, `0` and `'x'`, not `null`. ⛔ Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling: this card is a question.

## The split (measured by the dev; this seat read the declaration and the core branch)

| Reader | `packages: null` |
|:--|:--|
| `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.packages` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, `z.array(ArtifactPackageSchema).optional()`) | refused: `invalid_type` (`.optional()` admits `undefined`, not `null`) |
| `composeStacks` | refused: `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` |
| `@objectstack/core` `resolveArtifactPackageOrder` (`artifact-packages.ts`: `if (declared === undefined \|\| declared === null) return [artifact];`) | absent: `[artifact]` |
| `@objectstack/runtime` `resolveArtifactCollections` (after PR #19924) | absent: identity |
| `@objectstack/plugin-dev` `stackDeclaresTranslations` | absent: `false` |
| `@objectstack/plugin-security` `declaredDefaultPermissionSetName` | absent: `undefined` |

The readers agree with each other. The declared contract says otherwise.

## The question

Is `null` malformed, as the schema says, or absent, as the readers say? Whichever way it goes, one side changes. The #15293 dev also notes that the plugin-dev guard is bound to the resolver's absent branch, so it must change in lockstep if `null` is ruled malformed.

Seam: `spec:ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.packages` → `core:packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts resolveArtifactPackageOrder`

Dedupe words: `packages null absent` · `null packages optional refused` · `resolveArtifactPackageOrder null` · `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID packages null`
